6.1 后 BERT 时代的架构
Post-BERT Architectures

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Post-BERT Era — Post-BERT Architectures

Learning goals

  • Developments of the post-BERT era
  • Different self-supervised objectives
  • How to tackle BERTs critical shortcomings

目标: 了解后 BERT 时代的发展; 不同的自监督目标 (ELECTRA 的替换词元检测, XLNet 的排列语言建模); 怎样解决 BERT 的关键缺陷 (5.1 节的 (3)、(4): 预训练-微调不一致、独立性假设、只从 15% 的词元学习).

原文笔误: 「BERTs critical shortcomings」应为 BERT's.

Slide 1 (5 animation steps merged)

Successors of BERT

February 2019 - GPT2: Radford et al., 2019 massively scale up their GPT model from 2018 (up to 1.5 billion parameters). Despite the size, there are only smaller architectural changer, thus it remains a unidirectionally contextual model. Controversial debate about this model, since OpenAI (at ﬁrst) refuses to make their pre-trained architecture publicly available due to concerns about “malicious applications”.

June 2019 - XLNet: Yang et al., 2019 design a new pre-training objective in order to overcome some weaknesses they spotted in the one used by BERT. The use Permutation Language Modelling to avoid the discrepancy between pre-training and ﬁne-tuning introduced by the artiﬁcial MASK token.

October 2019 - T5: T5 (Raffel et al., 2019) a complete encoder-decoder Transformer based architecture (text-to-text transfer transformer). They approach transfer learning by transforming all inputs as well as all outputs to strings and ﬁne-tuned their model simultaneously on data sets with multiple different tasks.

March 2020 - ELECTRA: ELECTRA (Clark et al., 2020) introduces a discriminative pre-training strategy, allowing for a more efﬁcient use of the pre-training corpus. Despite requiring two models, the computational costs, for achieving a similar performance, are reduced to this gain in efﬁciency.

  • GPT-2 (2019-02): OpenAI 把 2018 年的 GPT 大幅放大 (最大 15 亿参数); 结构只有小改动, 仍是单向的. 曾引发争议: OpenAI 起初以「可能被恶意使用」为由不公开预训练模型 (第 7 章).
  • XLNet (2019-06): 针对 BERT 预训练目标的弱点设计新目标: 排列语言建模, 避免人造 [MASK] 带来的预训练-微调不一致 (本节后半).
  • T5 (2019-10): 完整的编码器-解码器 Transformer, 把所有输入和输出都变成字符串, 在多种任务的数据上同时微调 (6.2、6.3 节).
  • ELECTRA (2020-03): 判别式预训练策略, 更高效地利用预训练语料; 虽然要两个模型, 但达到同等性能所需的计算量反而更少 (本节前半).

原文笔误: 「architectural changer」应为 changes; 「The use Permutation Language Modelling」应为 They use; 「are reduced to this gain in efﬁciency」应为 due to; 时间轴左端的「1943」是模板残留.

ELECTRA
ELECTRA

Slide 2

Different pre-training regimes (1) — ELECTRA (Clark et al, 2020)

  • ELECTRA consinsts of two separate models
    → (Small) generator model G + (large) Discriminator model D
    → This might resemble a GAN setup, but they are not trained in an adversarial manner
  • Generator task: Masked language modeling
  • Discriminator task: Replaced token detection
    → Predict for each token, whether it is "original" or produced by G
  • ELECTRA learns from all of the tokens (not just from a small portion of 15%, like e.g. BERT)

ELECTRA 由两个模型组成: 一个 (小的) 生成器 G 和一个 (大的) 判别器 D. 看起来像 GAN (生成对抗网络), 但两者不是对抗训练的: G 并不试图骗过 D, 只是做自己的 MLM.

  • 生成器的任务: 掩码语言建模, 把 [MASK] 填上它猜的词.
  • 判别器的任务: 替换词元检测 (Replaced Token Detection, RTD): 对每个词元判断它是原文的还是 G 生成的.

关键优势: ELECTRA 从所有词元学习, 而 BERT 只从被选中的 15% 学习 (5.1 Slide 5 的缺陷).

原文笔误: 「consinsts」应为 consists.

Slide 3

ELECTRA – Architecture — Joint pre-training:

  • G and D are (Transformer) encoders which are trained jointly
  • G replaces [MASK]s in an input sequence
    → Passes corrupted input sequence xcorrupt to D

读图: 原句「the chef cooked the meal」, 遮住 the 和 cooked. 生成器 (一个小的 MLM) 采样填空: 第一个 [MASK] 填回 the (碰巧对了), 第二个填成 ate (错了). 被篡改的句子「the chef ate the meal」送进判别器 ELECTRA, 它对每个位置输出 original / replaced: 只有 ate 是 replaced. 注意 G 填对的 the 算 original.

G 和 D 都是 Transformer 编码器, 一起训练. 预训练结束后扔掉生成器, 只把判别器拿去微调下游任务.

Slide 4

ELECTRA – Training details — Joint pre-training:

  • Generation of samples:
    mi​∼unif{1,n} for i=1 to kxmasked=REPLACE(x,m,[MASK])
    x^i​∼pG​(xi​∣xmasked) for i∈mxcorrupt=REPLACE(x,m,x^)
    with approx. 15% of the tokens masked out (via choice of k)
  • D predicts whether xt​,t∈1,…,T is "real" or generated by G
    • Softmax output layer for G (probability distr. over all words)
    • Sigmoid output layer for D (Binary classification real vs. generated)

样本生成: 从 1 到 n 均匀随机选 k 个位置 m (k 取长度的约 15%), 换成 [MASK] 得到 xmasked; 生成器在这些位置按自己的分布采样出词 x^i​, 填进去得到 xcorrupt. 判别器对每个位置 t 预测真假. 输出层: G 用 softmax (整个词表上的分布), D 用 sigmoid (二分类).

Slide 5

Using the masked & corrupted input sequences, the (joint) loss can be written down as follows:

Loss functions:

LMLM​(x,θG​)=E(i∈m∑​−logpG​(xi​∣xmasked))
LDisc​(x,θD​)=E(t=1∑n​−1(xtcorrupt​=xt​)logD(xcorrupt,t)−1(xtcorrupt​=xt​)log(1−D(xcorrupt,t)))

Combined:

θG​,θD​min​x∈X∑​LMLM​(x,θG​)+λLDisc​(x,θD​)

with λ set to 50, since the discriminator’s loss is typically much lower than the geneator’s.

损失: 生成器是普通的 MLM 损失 (被遮位置的负对数似然). 判别器是逐位置的二元交叉熵: D(·, t) 是「位置 t 是原词」的概率; 原词时罚 −log D, 被替换时罚 −log(1 − D); 对全部 n 个位置求和. 合起来最小化 LMLM​+λLDisc​, λ = 50, 因为判别器的损失通常小得多 (二分类, 大部分位置都是原词, 很好猜).

为什么不是对抗训练: 生成器的采样操作不可导, 判别器的损失没法反传到生成器; 所以 G 只按 MLM 训练, 不管 D 是否被骗.

原文笔误: 「geneator」应为 generator.

Slide 6

Generator size:

  • Same size of G and D:
    Twice the compute per training step + too challenging for D
  • Smaller Generators are preferable (1/4 – 1/2 the size of D)

Weight sharing (experimental):

  • Same size of G and D: All weights can be tied
  • G smaller than D: Share token & positional embeddings

生成器多大合适? G 和 D 一样大时: 每步计算量翻倍, 而且生成器太强、填的词太像真的, 判别器的任务太难. 更小的生成器更好, 约为判别器的 1/4 到 1/2.

读图: 横轴是生成器大小 (隐藏维度, unigram 表示按词频随机填词), 三条线是判别器大小 768 / 512 / 256. 判别器 768 时, 生成器 256 左右 GLUE 最高 (约 84.9), 生成器再大反而下降. 其他两条线也是在中等大小处达到峰值.

权重共享 (实验性): 大小相同时可以共享全部权重; G 比 D 小时只共享词元和位置嵌入 (这样 G 的 MLM 训练也能改善 D 的嵌入).

Slide 7

ELECTRA – Model comparison

Note: Different batch sizes (2k vs. 8k) for ELECTRA vs. RoBERTa/XLNet explain why same number of steps lead to approx. 1/4 of the compute for ELECTRA.

读图: 横轴是预训练 FLOPs, 纵轴是 GLUE 分数. 红线 (替换词元检测, ELECTRA) 始终在蓝线 (掩码语言建模, BERT、RoBERTa) 上方: 同样的计算量, ELECTRA 更好; ELECTRA-Small 甚至超过了 GPT 和 ELMo. 右图把横轴放大到 1021: ELECTRA-Large 训练 400K 步就达到 RoBERTa 500K 步、XLNet 的水平, 计算量约只有 1/4.

注: 「同样步数只要约 1/4 计算量」是因为 ELECTRA 的批大小是 2K, RoBERTa/XLNet 是 8K.

自回归与自编码
Different pre-training regimes (2)

Slide 9

Autoregressive (AR) language modeling

  • Factorizes likelihood to
    p(x)=t=1∏T​p(xt​∣x<t​)
  • Only uni-directional (backward factorization also possible)

vs. (Denoising) Autoencoding (AE)

  • Reconstruct masked tokens xˉ from corrupted sequence x^:
    p(xˉ∣x^)=t=1∏T​mt​⋅p(xt​∣x^), with mt​ as masking indicator
  • Possible "corruptions" (besides MLM):
    → Replacing words with predictions (cf. ELECTRA)
    → Shuffling tokens or dropping them

两大预训练范式 (XLNet 论文的说法):

  • 自回归 (AR): 用链式法则把似然分解成逐词条件概率, 只能单向 (也可以从右往左分解). GPT 属于这一类.
  • (去噪) 自编码 (AE): 从被破坏的序列 x^ 重建被遮住的词元 xˉ. mt​ = 1 表示位置 t 被遮住. BERT 属于这一类. 除了 MLM 的遮挡, 「破坏」还可以是: 用预测替换词 (ELECTRA)、打乱或删除词元 (BART, 6.2 节).

幻灯片错误: AE 公式写成 ∏t​mt​⋅p(xt​∣x^), 只要有一个位置没被遮 (mt​=0), 整个乘积就是 0. 正确写法 (XLNet 论文): 对数形式 logp(xˉ∣x^)≈∑t=1T​mt​logp(xt​∣x^), 或者把 mt​ 写成指数 ∏t​p(xt​∣x^)mt​. 而且这里是「≈」: 它正是下页说的独立性假设.

Slide 10

Conceptual Differences

  • AR: No corruption of input sequences required
  • “Causal“ structure in AR approach (sometimes needed)
  • AE: Assumes independence between corrupted tokens
  • Question: Why?
  • AR approach only conditions on left side context
    → No bidirectionality possible

概念上的区别: AR 不需要破坏输入 (没有 [MASK], 所以没有预训练-微调不一致); AR 有「因果」结构, 生成文本时正需要它. AE 假设被破坏的词元之间相互独立. 问: 为什么? 答: 每个被遮词元都只以 x^ (未遮部分) 为条件单独预测, 公式把联合概率写成了各位置概率之积 (见 5.1 Slide 6 的 New York 例子). 反过来, AR 只以左侧上下文为条件, 无法双向.

两者各有优缺点, XLNet 想兼得: 保留 AR 的形式 (没有 [MASK]、没有独立性假设), 又能看到双向上下文.

排列语言建模 (XLNet)
Permutation language modeling (PLM)

Slide 11

XLNet (Yang et al., 2019)

  • Alternative objective function
  • Solves the pretrain-finetune discrepancy
    → No artificial [MASK] token is introduced
  • Allows for bidirectionality while keeping an AR objective
    → Best of both worlds
  • Consists of two "streams" of the Attention mechanism
    • Content-stream attention
    • Query-stream attention

XLNet: 另一种目标函数. 不引入人造的 [MASK], 解决了预训练-微调不一致; 保持自回归目标的同时又能利用双向上下文, 兼得两者之长. 实现上注意力有两条「流」: 内容流和查询流.

Slide 12

Manipulating the factorization order

  • Consider permutations z of the index sequence [1, 2, . . . , T]
    → Used to permute the factorization order, not the sequence order.
  • Original order of the sequence is retained via positional encodings
  • PLM objective (with ZT​ as set of all possible permutations):
    θmax​ Ez∼ZT​​[t=1∑T​logpθ​(xzt​​∣xz<t​​)]

核心想法: 对位置序号 [1, …, T] 随机取一个排列 z, 按 z 的顺序做自回归: 先预测位置 z1​ 的词, 再以它为条件预测 z2​…… 打乱的只是分解顺序 (先猜谁后猜谁), 不是句子本身的词序: 输入的句子顺序不变, 位置编码照旧.

例: 句子 x1 x2 x3 x4, 排列 3 → 2 → 4 → 1: 先猜 x3 (无条件), 再猜 x2 | x3, 再猜 x4 | x3, x2, 最后 x1 | x3, x2, x4. x2 用到了它右边的 x3. 对所有排列取期望, 每个位置都会在某些排列里看到左右两边的词: 从而双向. 实现时不真的重排输入, 而是用注意力掩码控制「谁能看到谁」.

Slide 13

PLM – Content- vs. query-stream — Content-stream

  • “Ordinary“ Self-Attention (with special attention masks)
    → Attentions masks depend on the factorization order
  • Information about the position in the sequence is lost, see Example in A.1 (Yang et al., 2019)
  • Sets of queries (Q), keys (K) and values (V) from content stream*
  • Yields a content embedding denoted as hθ​(xz≤t​​)

*For a nice visual disentanglement, see Figures in A.7 (Yang et al., 2019)

内容流: 就是普通的自注意力, 只是加了取决于分解顺序的注意力掩码: 位置 zt​ 能看到排列中在它之前的位置以及它自己. Q、K、V 都来自内容流. 输出 hθ​(xz≤t​​), 和 BERT/GPT 的隐状态一样, 包含这个位置自己的词.

幻灯片说法不准确: 「Information about the position in the sequence is lost」不是内容流的性质, 而是下一页 A.1 说的问题: 如果只用普通的参数化 p(x∣h(xz<t​​)) 来预测, 模型不知道要预测的是哪个位置. 这正是引入查询流的原因.

Slide 14

附录 A.1 的例子: 两个排列 z(1) 和 z(2) 前面的部分相同 (z<t(1)​=z<t(2)​), 但第 t 步要预测的位置不同 (i ≠ j). 用普通的 softmax(e(x)⊤h(xz<t​​)) 参数化时, 两种情况的条件完全一样, 于是给出相同的预测分布. 但位置 i 和 j 上的真实词分布显然应该不同 (例如一个是句首, 一个是句尾). 所以预测时必须告诉模型「目标位置是哪里」.

Slide 15

Query-stream

  • Access to context through content-stream, but no access to the content of the current position (only location information)
  • Q from the query stream, K and V from the content stream*
  • Yields a query embedding denoted as gθ​(xz<t​​,zt​)

*For a nice visual disentanglement, see Figures in A.7 (Yang et al., 2019)

查询流: 通过内容流获取上下文 (K、V 来自内容流), 但看不到当前位置的内容, 只知道当前位置在哪里 (位置信息 zt​). Q 来自查询流自己. 输出 gθ​(xz<t​​,zt​), 用来预测位置 zt​ 的词.

为什么要两条流: 预测 xzt​​ 时不能看到 xzt​​ 本身 (否则作弊), 但要知道它的位置 → 查询流; 而这个词在之后的步骤里又要作为上下文被别的位置使用, 那时需要它的完整内容 → 内容流. 一个表示无法同时满足两者.

Slide 16–17

读图: 分解顺序 3 → 2 → 4 → 1, 每张小图是一个位置的视角 (Position-1/2/3/4 View), 下面一排是输入 (各位置的内容 x 和词元嵌入 w), 上面两层是第 1、2 层的表示; mem 是 Transformer-XL 式的缓存记忆 (3.5 节).

  • 内容流 (上图): 位置 3 排第一, 只能看自己 (和 mem); 位置 2 能看 3 和自己; 位置 4 能看 3, 2 和自己; 位置 1 能看所有位置.
  • 查询流 (下图): 同样的可见范围, 但不包括自己的内容: 位置 3 的查询只能看 mem; 位置 1 能看 2, 3, 4. 每个查询表示 g 从可学习的向量 w 出发, 只带位置信息.
Slide 18

读图: (a) 内容流: h1​ 的查询来自 h1​ 自己, 键和值来自所有可见位置 (含自己). (b) 查询流: g1​ 的查询来自 g1​, 键和值来自内容流里可见的位置 (不含位置 1 自己的内容). (c) 整个模型: 两条流并行地逐层计算 (Masked Two-stream Attention), 右边是两种注意力掩码矩阵: 内容流的掩码对角线可见 (can see self), 查询流的掩码对角线不可见 (cannot see self). 最上面用查询流的输出 g 预测各位置的词.

Slide 19

XLNet – Model input

Generation of samples:

  • Randomly sample two sentences and use concatenation* as input
[CLS] The fox is quick . [SEP]
It jumps over the lazy dog . [SEP]

*Nevertheless: XLNet does not use the NSP objective

Additional encodings:

  • Relative segment encodings:
    • BERT adds absolute segment embeddings (EA​ & EB​)
    • XLNet uses relative encodings (s+​ & s−​)
  • Relative Positional encodings:
    • BERT encodes information about the absolute position (E0​,E1​,E2​,…)
    • XLNet uses relative encodings (Ri−j​)

输入: 随机抽两个句子拼接 (但 XLNet 不用 NSP 目标). 额外的编码:

  • 相对片段编码: BERT 给两句加绝对的片段嵌入 EA​,EB​; XLNet 只编码「两个位置是否属于同一片段」 (s+​ 同一片段, s−​ 不同片段).
  • 相对位置编码: BERT 编码绝对位置; XLNet 用 Transformer-XL 的相对位置编码 Ri−j​ (3.5 节).

XLNet 的实际输入格式是 [A, SEP, B, SEP, CLS], [CLS] 放在最后 (不像 BERT 放在开头), 这样对自回归模型来说它能看到整句. 幻灯片的例子沿用了 BERT 的写法.

Slide 20

XLNet – Special remarks

  • Partial Prediction: Only predict the last tokens in a factoriztion order (reduces optimization difficulty)
    θmax​ Ez∼ZT​​[t=c+1∑∣z∣​logpθ​(xzt​​∣xz<t​​)], with c as cutting point
  • Segment recurrence mechanism: Allow for learning extended contexts in Transformer-based architectures, see Dai et al. (2019)
  • No independence assumption:
    JBERT​JXLNet​​=logp(New∣is a city)+logp(York∣is a city),=logp(New∣is a city)+logp(York∣New,is a city)​
    Prediction of [New, York] given the factorization order [is, a, city, New, York] (Source: Yang et al., 2019)

其他要点:

  • 部分预测: 只预测排列中最后一部分 (切点 c 之后) 的词元. 排在前面的词元上下文太少, 很难预测, 去掉它们降低优化难度.
  • 片段循环: 采用 Transformer-XL 的机制学习更长的上下文 (XLNet 的名字就来自 Transformer-XL).
  • 没有独立性假设: 同 5.1 Slide 6 的例子, 按顺序 [is, a, city, New, York] 预测时, York 以 New 为条件.

原文笔误: 「factoriztion」应为 factorization.

Slide 21

XLNet – SOTA performance

读图: 上表是「公平比较」: 和 BERT 用相同数据和超参数 (BERT 取三个变体中最好的). XLNet-Large 在所有任务上都超过 BERT-Large, 例如 SQuAD 2.0 85.1/87.8 vs 82.8/85.5, RACE 77.4 vs 75.1, RTE 81.2 vs 74.0. 下表是 GLUE: 开发集上单任务单模型, XLNet 在多数任务上胜过 RoBERTa (MNLI 90.8/90.8 vs 90.2/90.2); 测试集排行榜 (集成模型) 上 XLNet 的各项都是粗体, 即全部最好.

6.2 把任务表述为文本到文本问题
Tasks as Text-to-Text Problem

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Post-BERT Era — Tasks as Text-to-Text Problem

Learning goals

  • Reformulating classification tasks
  • Multi-task learning
  • Fine-tuning on task-prefixes

目标: 把分类任务改写成文本生成; 多任务学习; 用任务前缀做微调.

BERT 的问题
Problems with BERT

Slide 1

Recap: BERT, RoBERTa, etc.

  • Transformer encoder
  • Training: Masked language modeling (or similar)
  • BERT* learns an enormous amount of knowledge about language and the world through MLM training on large corpora
  • Application: fine-tune on a particular task
  • Great performance!
  • Question: What’s not to like?

*In what follows we will use BERT as a representative for this class of language models, i.e. models with a custom classification layer of each task, and only talk about BERT – but the discussion includes RoBERTa, Albert, XLNet etc.

回顾 BERT 类模型: Transformer 编码器; 用 MLM (或类似目标) 训练; 从大语料里学到大量语言和世界知识; 应用时针对某个任务微调; 效果很好. 问: 那还有什么不满意的? 注: 下面用 BERT 代表这一类模型 (每个任务配一个专门的分类层), 讨论同样适用于 RoBERTa、ALBERT、XLNet 等.

Slide 2

Problems with BERT (1)

  • You need a different model for each task. (Because BERT is differently fine-tuned for each task.)
    → Not realistic in many real deployment scenarios, e.g., on mobile devices.
  • Human learning: We arguably have a single model that solves all tasks!
  • Question: Is there a framework that allows us to create a single model that solves all tasks?

问题 (1): 每个任务一个模型. 每个任务分别微调, 得到一份完整的模型副本. 在很多实际部署场景 (如手机) 里不现实: 十个任务就要存十个 BERT. 而人可以说只有一个「模型」, 能解决所有任务. 问: 有没有框架能做出一个解决所有任务的单一模型?

Slide 3–4

Problems with BERT (2)

  • Two training modes: first (MLM) pretraining, then fine-tuning.
  • Fine-tuning is supervised learning, i.e., learning from labeled examples.
  • Arguably, learning from labeled examples is untypical for human learning.
  • You never learn a task solely by being presented a bunch of examples, without explanation.
  • Instead, in human learning, there is almost always a task description.
  • Example: How to boil an egg.
    “Place eggs in the bottom of a saucepan.“
    “Fill the pan with cold water.“
    “Etc.“
  • Notice that this is not an example but a description of the task
  • Question: Is there a framework that allows us to leverage task descriptions?

问题 (2): 没有任务描述. 两种训练模式: 先 MLM 预训练, 再微调; 微调是有监督学习, 只从标注例子学. 但人几乎从不只靠一堆例子、毫无解释地学会一件事, 学习时几乎总有任务描述. 例如煮鸡蛋: 「把鸡蛋放在锅底」, 「往锅里加冷水」……这不是例子, 而是对任务的描述. 问: 有没有框架能利用任务描述?

Slide 5–6

Problems with BERT (3)

  • BERT has great performance, but . . .
  • . . . only if the training set is large, generally 1000s of examples
  • This is completely different from human learning!
  • We do use examples in learning, but in most cases, only a few
  • Example: Maybe the person teaching you how to boil an egg will show you how to do it one or two times
  • But probably not 10 times
  • Definitely not a 1000 times
  • More practical concern: it’s very expensive to label 1000s of examples for each task (there are many tasks).
  • Question: Is there a framework that allows us to learn from just a small number of examples?
  • This is called few-shot learning.

问题 (3): 要很多例子. BERT 效果好, 但前提是训练集大, 通常要几千个例子. 人学东西也看例子, 但大多只看几个: 教你煮鸡蛋的人可能示范一两次, 不会示范十次, 更不会一千次. 现实问题: 每个任务都标几千个例子很贵, 而任务又多. 问: 能不能只从少量例子学习? 这叫 few-shot learning 少样本学习 (第 7 章 GPT-3).

Slide 7

Problems with BERT (4)

  • More subtle aspect of the same problem (i.e., large training sets):
    → Overfitting
  • Even though performance looks good on standard train/dev/test splits, the deviation between the training set and the data actually encountered in real application can be large
  • So our benchmarks often overestimate what performance would be in reality

问题 (4): 过拟合. 同一问题 (依赖大训练集) 更隐蔽的一面: 在标准的训练/开发/测试划分上看起来很好, 但训练集和真实应用中遇到的数据可能差别很大 (分布偏移). 所以基准测试往往高估了实际表现: 模型可能学到了数据集特有的捷径.

Slide 8

Problems with BERT – Summary

  • No true multitask learning
  • Differs from the way humans learn
  • No possibility/necessity to make use of a description of the task
  • Overfitting

小结: 没有真正的多任务学习; 与人类学习方式不同; 没办法 (也没必要) 利用任务描述; 过拟合.

文本到文本
Revisiting text-to-text tasks

Slide 9

Example: Machine Translation

(Abbildung identisch mit 1.3 Slide 14: seq2seq-LSTM liest 「ABC」 und erzeugt 「WXYZ」. Source: Sutskever et al., 2014)

  • Input: Text in source language
  • Output: Text in target language

回顾文本到文本任务: 机器翻译 (图同 1.3 Slide 14), 输入源语言文本, 输出目标语言文本.

Slide 10

Revisiting fine-tuning of BERT

(Abbildung identisch mit 4.4 Slide 10: (a) sentence pair classification, (b) single sentence classification, (c) question answering, (d) single sentence tagging. Source: Devlin et al., 2019)

  • First row: (sequence-level) classification
  • Second row: sequence tagging = token-level classification

回顾 BERT 的微调 (图同 4.4 Slide 10): 第一行是 (序列级) 分类, 第二行是序列标注 = 词元级分类. 每种任务都要在 BERT 上接一个专门的输出层.

Slide 11

Fine-tuning + text-to-text?

  • Question: How does BERT know which task it is performing?
    • It doesn’t!
    • BERT just learns associations between text features and class distributions
    • No meaningful internal representation of what “class 3“ actually means
    • Input: text; Output: [0 0 1 0 0 0]
  • The fact that BERT does not “understand“ what task it is actually performing is the reason why one copy is needed per task

问: BERT 怎么知道自己在做哪个任务? 答: 它不知道! 它只是学到文本特征和类别分布之间的关联; 对「第 3 类」到底是什么意思没有有意义的内部表示. 输入文本, 输出一个类别编号向量 [0 0 1 0 0 0]. 正因为 BERT 不「理解」自己在做什么任务, 才需要每个任务一份副本.

Slide 12
  • Question: How could we “inform“ our model about the task?
    • Model takes text as an input and can process.
    • Why not describe the task in natural language?
    • Assumption:
      Given the model sees 1000s of (inputs; ouput) pairs like ..
      (“<task description>: <input sample>“ ; “<class name>“)
      .. it will learn to associate ..
      → .. task descriptions to a set of class names
      → .. text features to class name distributions

问: 怎样把任务「告诉」模型? 模型本来就以文本为输入, 那就用自然语言描述任务. 假设模型看到几千个这样的 (输入; 输出) 对: 输入是「任务描述: 输入样本」, 输出是类名本身 (文字, 不是编号). 它就会学会: 把任务描述和一组类名联系起来; 把文本特征和类名的分布联系起来.

原文笔误: 「ouput」应为 output; 「Model takes text as an input and can process」句子不完整 (… can process it).

Slide 13
  • Question: How does a “good“ task description look like?
    • Remember: The idea is to have a model that learns to associate the task descriptions with a set of class names
    • Class names:
      → Could be pretty new/exotic terms the model is not familiar with after pre-training
      → It will learn to output them during fine-tuning when “triggered“ accordingly (i.e. with the right task description)
    • Task descriptions:
      → Might be possible that the the model already saw some task descriptions during pre-training and has a meaningful representation for them.
      → On the other hand: Others might also be pretty new/exotic.

问: 「好的」任务描述长什么样? 记住目标是让模型把任务描述和一组类名联系起来. 类名: 可以是预训练后模型不熟悉的新奇词, 微调时它会学会在相应的任务描述「触发」下输出它们. 任务描述: 有些可能模型在预训练中见过 (如 「sentiment」), 已有有意义的表示; 另一些也可能很新奇.

原文笔误: 「How does a good task description look like」应为 What does … look like (或 How does … look); 「the the model」多了一个 the.

Slide 14

For sentiment classification, I can just provide it with 1000s of training samples like

(“<sentiment classification>: <input sample>“ ; “<positive/negative>“)

The model will ..

  • .. utilize already present knowledge about the task description.
  • .. learn to associate the task description precisely with this label set

例: 情感分类, 给模型几千个「sentiment classification: 输入文本」→「positive / negative」的样本. 模型会利用已有的关于「sentiment」这个描述的知识, 并学会把这个描述精确地对应到这组标签.

Slide 15 (2 animation steps merged)
  • Question: If I want the model to do sentiment classification, can I also just provide it with 1000s of training samples like
    (“<khaleesi>: <input sample>“ ; “<positive/negative>“)?
    (khaleesi1 just used as some random fantasy word here)
  • Intuition: Yes! It basically does not matter, as long as the model is fine-tuned on this data2
  • Fine-tuning important for the model to pick up on this “signal“ and output according text (corresponding the appropriate classes)

1 Khaleesi is a Dothraki title referring to the wife of the khal (cf. Game of Thrones).
2 Of course, using “good“ task descriptions (as shown on the previous slide) that are also meaningful to human readers make more sense as the model might learn quicker because they diverge less from the pre-training distribution.

问: 如果用一个随便的幻想词 「khaleesi」 (《权力的游戏》里多斯拉克语对卡奥之妻的称呼) 当任务描述, 也给几千个样本, 行不行? 直觉: 行! 只要在这些数据上微调, 用什么词基本无所谓. 关键在于微调让模型捕捉到这个「信号」, 并输出对应类别的文字.

脚注 2: 当然, 用对人也有意义的「好」描述更合理, 因为它与预训练的数据分布差得少, 模型学得更快. 这也是任务前缀和下一章提示 (prompting) 的关键区别: 有微调时描述的措辞不太重要; 不微调时措辞就非常重要 (6.3 Slide 5).

多任务学习
Multi-task learning?

Slide 16

Taxonomy of transfer learning (Source: Ruder, 2019)

读图: 与 1.2 Slide 10 是同一棵树, 但课件用红笔把「Multi-task learning 多任务学习」圈出来, 把「Sequential transfer learning 顺序迁移学习」划掉, 并在「simultaneously 同时学」下面画线: 意思是从 BERT 的「先预训练再逐个微调」(顺序迁移) 转向 T5 的「同时学多个任务」(多任务).

Slide 17
  • Question: If the model can learn to link task descriptions to label sets, can it learn to perform multiple tasks at once?
  • Yes, through fine tuning each task description1 will be linked to its label set:
    • <task description a> → {positive, negative}
    • <task description b> → {world, sports, business, sci/tech} (Example from AG News)
    • <task description c> → {spam, no spam}
    • <task description d> → {entailment, contradiction, neutral}

1 <task description a> (and so on) are just placeholders here.

既然模型能把任务描述和标签集联系起来, 能否同时做多个任务? 能: 通过微调, 每个任务描述都会对应到自己的标签集: 情感 → {正, 负}; 新闻主题 (AG News) → {世界, 体育, 商业, 科技}; 垃圾邮件 → {是, 否}; 自然语言推理 → {蕴含, 矛盾, 中立}. 把这些任务的数据混在一起训练一个模型即可.

Slide 18
  • Question: Can we have one single model for both different classification tasks and generation tasks?
    • Yes, we just have to design suitable task descriptions
    • Examples for generative descriptions (Raffel et al., 2020)
      translate English to German: <input sample>
      summarize: <input sample>
      answer question: <input sample>
    • Examples for classification descriptions (Raffel et al., 2020)
      binary classification: <input sample>
      predict sentiment: <input sample>

分类任务和生成任务也能放进同一个模型吗? 能, 只要设计合适的任务描述. 生成任务: 「translate English to German:」, 「summarize:」, 「answer question:」; 分类任务: 「binary classification:」, 「predict sentiment:」. 因为输出都是文本, 分类只不过是「生成一个类名」.

Slide 19

Text-to-text tasks

(Abbildung identisch mit 1.3 Slide 11: T5 mit 「translate English to German」, 「cola sentence」, 「stsb sentence1 … sentence2」, 「summarize」. Source: Raffel et al., 2020)

Important note: What we talked about as <task description> until now is commonly referred to as <task prefix>

T5 的示意图, 同 1.3 Slide 11. 注意术语: 前面说的「任务描述」, 通常叫task prefix 任务前缀.

6.3 文本到文本迁移 Transformer (T5)
Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Post-BERT Era — Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer

Learning goals

  • Shortcomings of BERT & Co.
  • Everything as text-to-text

目标: BERT 等模型的不足 (上一节); 把一切任务都写成文本到文本.

T5 概览
Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer

Slide 1

Revisiting text-to-text tasks

(Abbildung identisch mit 1.3 Slide 11. Source: Raffel et al., 2020)

Ingredients:

  • <task prefix> for each task
    → Concatenation with the input
  • Output label / score formatted as string

两个要素: 每个任务一个任务前缀, 拼在输入前面; 输出的标签或分数都写成字符串 (STS-B 的相似度 3.8 也输出成文字 「3.8」).

Slide 2

Short summary:

  • In short: T5 (bc of the five Ts)
  • A complete encoder-decoder Transformer architecture
  • Question: Why is this important?
  • Relative positional embeddings
  • All tasks reformulated as text-to-text tasks
    → Probably the most important innovation of this work
  • From BERT-size ×2 (since enc-dec) up to 11B parameters
  • Paradigm shift from Sequential Transfer Learning towards true Multi-Task Learning

Nice Animation (similar to figure before)

T5 = Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer, 五个 T. 要点:

  • 完整的编码器-解码器 Transformer. 问: 为什么重要? 答: 输出是任意长度的文本, 必须有解码器才能生成; BERT 只有编码器, 只能给每个输入位置打分.
  • 相对位置嵌入 (3.5 节思路).
  • 所有任务都改写成文本到文本: 大概是这项工作最重要的创新.
  • 规模从约 BERT 的两倍 (因为有编码器和解码器两半) 到 110 亿参数.
  • 范式转变: 从顺序迁移学习转向真正的多任务学习 (6.2 Slide 16).
Slide 3

Input and output format

Input Side:

  • SentencePiece framework w/ WordPiece tokens
  • Add task-specific (text) prefix to the original input
  • Choice of the prefix: Hyperparameter!!
    → Changing this had limited impact
    → No extensive experiments performed by the authors

Output Side:

  • Output as a word or a piece of text (also numerical similarity scores)
  • If output not present in set of potential alternatives, prediction considered as wrong (many other possible ways; this is not trivial)

输入端: 用 SentencePiece 工具做 WordPiece 式的子词切分 (词表 32 000); 在原输入前加任务前缀. 前缀的选择是一个超参数! 但改变它影响有限, 作者也没有做大量实验 (原因见下页).

输出端: 输出一个词或一段文本 (相似度分数也写成文字). 如果输出不在候选答案集合里 (例如情感任务输出了「hamburger」), 就算错. 这只是一种处理方式, 并不简单: 也可以选与候选最接近的那个, 或者只在候选上比较概率.

Slide 4

Task prefix vs. prompting

Adding task-specific (text) prefix:

  • Add task-specific (text) prefix to the original input
  • Model is fine-tuned on samples prepended with this prefix
    → It learns to recognize what it is expected to do when encountering a specific prefix at test time
    → Probably because of this: limited impact found by the authors

Prompting:

  • Refers to just querying a trained w/o fine-tuning it (cf. next chapter)
  • Paradigm of Few-/Zero-Shot Learning
  • This is found to have a huge impact on model performance

任务前缀 vs. 提示:

  • 任务前缀: 模型在加了前缀的样本上微调, 学会在测试时看到某个前缀就知道该做什么. 正因为有微调, 前缀的措辞影响不大 (6.2 Slide 15 的 khaleesi).
  • 提示: 只是查询一个训练好的模型, 不微调 (下一章), 属于少样本/零样本学习的范式. 这时提示的写法对性能影响巨大.

原文笔误: 「querying a trained w/o fine-tuning it」漏了 model (a trained model).

Slide 5

Architectural differences

Attention patterns (top) and Schematics of considered architectures (bottom)

读图: 上面三个掩码矩阵 (横轴输入, 纵轴输出, 深色 = 可以看到):

  • 完全可见 (fully-visible): 每个位置看所有位置 (BERT、编码器).
  • 因果 (causal): 下三角, 只看自己和之前的位置 (GPT、解码器, 3.3 节).
  • 带前缀的因果 (causal with prefix): 前缀部分完全可见, 之后的部分因果.

下面三种架构: 编码器-解码器 (编码器完全可见, 解码器因果并交叉注意编码器, 即原始 Transformer、T5); 语言模型 (单个因果的 Transformer 栈, 输入和输出连在一起); 前缀语言模型 (单个栈, 但输入部分用完全可见的掩码). T5 论文比较了这三种, 编码器-解码器最好.

Slide 6

Pre-training objective

  1. Mark spans in input sequence for corruptions
  2. Replace tokens with sentinel tokens
  3. Predict sentinel tokens and replaced tokens

T5 的预训练目标 span corruption 片段破坏: (1) 在输入里随机标出要破坏的片段 (例中 「for inviting」 和 「last」); (2) 每个片段整体换成一个哨兵词元 (sentinel) <X>, <Y>, …; (3) 目标输出是「哨兵 + 被替换的原词」, 最后以哨兵 <Z> 结束: 「<X> for inviting <Y> last <Z>」.

和 BERT 的 MLM 比: 一个片段只用一个哨兵, 输入更短; 目标只包含被遮的部分, 不用重建整句, 计算更省. 这仍是一种去噪 (denoising) 目标.

Slide 7

Pre-training objectives

  • Authors experimented with different objectives
  • Most of them rely in some way on MLM

作者试了多种目标, 大多和 MLM 有关. 用例句「Thank you for inviting me to your party last week.」 说明: 前缀语言模型 (输入前半句, 生成后半句); BERT 式 (遮词和随机替换, 目标是原句); 打乱顺序 (deshuffling); MASS 式; i.i.d. 噪声替换片段 (即 Slide 6 的做法); i.i.d. 噪声删除词元; 随机片段. 注意 BERT 式的输入里有一个随机替换词 「apple」.

Slide 8

读图: T5 论文按四步逐级缩小选择: 高层方法 (语言建模 / BERT 式 / 打乱, BERT 式最好) → 破坏策略 (遮词 / 替换片段 / 删除, 替换片段兼顾效果和效率) → 破坏率 (10%、15%、25%、50%, 15% 合适) → 被破坏片段的平均长度 (2、3、5、10, 选 3). 每一步固定前一步的最佳选择.

Slide 9

The Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus (C4)

  • Effort to measure the effect of quality, characteristics & size of the pre-training resources
  • Common Crawl as basis, careful cleaning and filtering for English language
  • Orders of magnitude larger (750GB) compared to commonly used corpora

C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus): 为了衡量预训练数据的质量、特点和规模的影响而构建. 以 Common Crawl (网页爬取) 为基础, 仔细清洗 (去掉太短的行、含脏话的页面、代码、重复内容等), 只保留英语. 约 750 GB, 比当时常用的语料大好几个数量级 (BERT 的约 13–16 GB).

Slide 10

Experiments (with respect to C4)

读图: 上表: 用不同数据集预训练. 未过滤的 C4 (6.1 TB) 明显比清洗后的 C4 (745 GB) 差 (GLUE 81.46 vs 83.28), 说明清洗很重要; 领域相关的小数据集在对应任务上更好 (如 Wikipedia + TBC 在 SuperGLUE 上 73.24, 因为它含书籍类文本). 下表: 把 C4 截成 229 … 223 个词元, 训练中重复 64 … 4096 次: 重复越多 (数据越少), 效果越差, 223 时 GLUE 掉到 76.34. 结论: 数据要多, 尽量避免重复.

Slide 11

T5 - Exhaustive experiments

Performed experiments with respect to ..

  • .. architecture, size & objective
    → enc, dec, enc-dec
    → Between 60M and 11B parameters
  • .. details of the Denoising objective (which was found to work best)
  • .. fine-tuning methods
    → Adapter layers
    → Gradual Unfreezing (cf. ULMFiT)
  • .. Multi-task learning strategies
    → Examples-proportional mixing
    → Temperature-scaled mixing

T5 论文的系统实验涉及: 架构 (编码器、解码器、编码器-解码器)、规模 (60M 到 11B)、目标; 去噪目标的细节 (去噪目标效果最好); 微调方法 (adapter 层: 只在每层插入少量新参数来训练; 逐层解冻: 像 ULMFiT 那样从顶层开始逐步放开参数); 多任务学习的数据混合策略 (按样本数比例混合; 带温度的混合, 让小数据集不至于被淹没).

Slide 12–14

Benchmark results

读图: 五个尺寸 (Small 到 11B) 与此前最好结果 (Previous best) 比较, 规模越大越好. T5-11B 在 GLUE 平均 (90.3)、SQuAD (91.26 EM)、SuperGLUE (88.9, 接近人类水平 89.8)、CNN/DM 摘要 (ROUGE-1 43.52) 上都是新的最好成绩. 例外是机器翻译: WMT 英德、英法、英罗都没有超过此前最好 (如英德 32.1 vs 33.8). 原因是之前的翻译系统用了回译等专门技术和双语数据, 而 T5 只在英语的 C4 上预训练.

Slide 15

Conclusions

  • Encoder-decoder architecture works best in this "text-to-text" setting
  • More data, larger models & ensembling all boost the performance
    • Larger models trained for fewer steps better than smaller models on more data
    • Ensembling: Using same base pre-trained models worse than complete separate model ensembles
  • Different denoising objectives work similarly well
  • Updating all model parameters during fine-tuning works best (but expensive)

结论: 在文本到文本设置下编码器-解码器最好; 更多数据、更大模型、集成都能提升性能, 其中, 同样的计算量, 大模型训练较少步数优于小模型训练更多数据; 集成时, 从同一个预训练模型分别微调出的成员, 不如完全独立预训练的成员. 不同的去噪目标效果相近. 微调时更新全部参数效果最好 (但最贵, 胜过 adapter 和逐层解冻).

T5 的参数量
Different T5 versions and parameter count

Slide 16

Similar to BERT T5 has different versions, which all have a different parameter count (Raffel et al., 2020)

ModelParametersnlayers​dmodel​dFFN​dqkv​nheads​
small60M65122048648
base220M1276830726412
large770M24102440966416
3B3B2410241638412832
11B11B24102465536128128

For T5 small, base and large we have the following parameter count per encoder/decoder layer:

NEncoder​=12⋅dmodel2​NDecoder​=16⋅dmodel2​

For T5 3B and 11B NEncoder​ and NDecoder​ are different!

T5 的五个版本. 前三个满足 dFFN​=4dmodel​、dqkv​⋅nheads​=dmodel​, 可以直接用 3.4 节的近似: 编码器层 12d2, 解码器层 16d2. 3B 和 11B 不满足这两个条件 (维度都是 1024, 但前馈层宽得多, 头数和每头维度的乘积也不等于 1024), 要单独算.

Slide 17

Approximate parameter count (1)

The general formula is:

NTotal​=nlayers​⋅(NEncoder​+NDecoder​)+NEmbedding​

Let V = 32000 be the size of the vocabulary, we then have: NEmbedding​=32000×dmodel​

  • T5 small: Nsmall​=6⋅(12⋅5122+16⋅5122)+32000×512=60,424,192
  • T5 base: Nbase​=12⋅(12⋅7682+16⋅7682)+32000×768=222,756,864
  • T5 large: Nlarge​=24⋅(12⋅10242+16⋅10242)+32000×1024=737,411,072

总参数 = 层数 × (一层编码器 + 一层解码器) + 嵌入. 词表 32 000, 编码器和解码器共享一个嵌入矩阵, 所以嵌入只算一次. 三个结果 (6042 万、2.23 亿、7.37 亿) 我都用 Python 核对过, 与论文报告的 60M、220M、770M 相符.

Slide 18

Revisiting: MHA and FFN (1)

  • In the transformer chapter we derived the FFN parameter count to be 8⋅dmodel2​
  • We also derived the MHA parameter count to be 4⋅dmodel2​
  • But this is only the case if we choose dFFN​=4⋅dmodel​ and dqkv​=nheads​dmodel​​, with dFFN​ being the hidden dimension of the FFN and dqkv​ being the embedding dimension of each head in MHA
  • For the two bigger model variants we have the following relations:
    • T5 3B: dFFN​=16⋅dmodel​ and dqkv​=nheads​dmodel​​
    • T5 11B: dFFN​=64⋅dmodel​ and dqkv​=nheads​dmodel​​
  • Thats why we can’t use the same formulas as for the three previous variants

回顾: 3.4 节推出的 FFN 8d2、MHA 4d2 只在 dFFN​=4d 且 dqkv​=d/nheads​ 时成立. 3B: dFFN​=16⋅1024, dqkv​=128=1024/32=32; 11B: dFFN​=64⋅1024, dqkv​=128=1024/128=8. 所以不能用原来的公式.

原文笔误: 「Thats」应为 That's.

Slide 19

Revisiting: MHA and FFN (2)

In MHA nheads​⋅dqkv​ is no longer dmodel​:

Nattention​=nheads​⋅dqkv​×dmodel​+(dmodel​×dqkv​)×nheads​⋅3=4⋅nheads​⋅dqkv​×dmodel​; instead of: 4⋅dmodel2​

For the FFN dFFN​ is no longer 4⋅dmodel​:

NFFN​=dmodel​×dFFN​+dFFN​×dmodel​=2⋅dmodel​×dFFN​; instead of: 8⋅dmodel2​

For the Encoder and Decoder that means:

NEncoder​NDecoder​​=4⋅nheads​⋅dqkv​×dmodel​+2⋅dmodel​×dFFN​=2⋅4⋅nheads​⋅dqkv​×dmodel​+2⋅dmodel​×dFFN​​

一般公式: 多头注意力里, 每个头的 Q、K、V 投影是 dmodel​×dqkv​, 共 3nheads​ 个; 输出投影 WO​ 把拼接后的 nheads​⋅dqkv​ 维映射回 dmodel​. 合计 4⋅nheads​⋅dqkv​⋅dmodel​. 前馈网络两层: 2⋅dmodel​⋅dFFN​ (忽略偏置). 编码器层 = 1 个注意力 + FFN, 解码器层 = 2 个注意力 + FFN. 代入 nheads​dqkv​=d, dFFN​=4d 就回到 12d2 和 16d2.

Slide 20

Approximate parameter count (2)

The general formula is still: NTotal​=nlayers​⋅(NEncoder​+NDecoder​)+NEmbedding​

  • T5 3B:
    N3B​=24⋅(+= ​[4⋅32⋅128×1024+2⋅1024×16384][2⋅4⋅32⋅128×1024+2⋅1024×16384])+32000⋅10242,851,340,288≈3B​
  • T5 11B:
    N11B​=24⋅(+= ​[4⋅128⋅128×1024+2⋅1024×65536][2⋅4⋅128⋅128×1024+2⋅1024×65536])+32000⋅102411,307,057,152≈11B​

代入: 3B 约 28.5 亿, 11B 约 113 亿, 与名字相符. 两个数我都用 Python 算过. 可以看到 11B 的参数主要在前馈层: 每层 FFN 有 2 × 1024 × 65 536 ≈ 1.34 亿参数, 而注意力只有 4 × 128 × 128 × 1024 ≈ 0.67 亿.
